description: This file defines the ConnectionIdInvalidException class, a custom exception used in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package to indicate an invalid ConnectionId. It includes builder methods, JSON deserialization, and relevant metadata.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException
classes.description: A final exception class indicating that a provided ConnectionId is invalid, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ConnectivityException. It includes a nested Builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: ConnectionIdInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for ConnectionIdInvalidException, providing a fluent API for setting exception fields and building the exception object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static method to create a new Builder instance for ConnectionIdInvalidException, optionally initializing the message with an ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to construct a ConnectionIdInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides method to set DittoHeaders on the exception instance, returning a new exception with updated headers.
